description.en: Model-driven context compression (ACP) for DeepSeek Harness, ported from billion-context-pi — the model decides when and what to compress.
description.zh-CN: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型驱动上下文压缩（ACP），移植自 billion-context-pi——由模型决定何时压缩、压缩什么。

description.en: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
description.zh-CN: 从用户授权的源码生成 Function、MCP 工具、工作流 Skill 与离线测试包。

description.en: A skill-driven workflow agent plugin for structured harness-loop engineering.
description.zh-CN: 面向结构化 Harness 循环工程的技能驱动工作流智能体 Plugin。

description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and a model-driven lifecycle.
description.zh-CN: 通过 Monaco 编辑器及模型驱动的生命周期创建和管理沙箱化 JavaScript 工具。

description.en: Open DeepSeek Harness workspace directories in VS Code from the web interface.
description.zh-CN: 可从 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面直接在 VS Code 中打开工作区目录。

description.en: Adds Codex-style @file mentions to search workspace files and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh-CN: 提供 Codex 风格的 @file 引用，可搜索工作区文件并将内容附加到提示词。

description.en: Automatically detects and decodes Bash output encodings including UTF-16LE, UTF-8, and GBK for Windows and WSL.
description.zh-CN: 自动识别并解码 UTF-16LE、UTF-8、GBK 等 Bash 输出编码，修复 Windows 与 WSL 下的乱码。

description.en: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
description.zh-CN: 编辑用户与内置系统提示词段落，支持实时预览。

description.en: A sidebar workbench with extensible tabs, file viewing and editing, terminal, Git, and sub-agent tools.
description.zh-CN: 完整的侧边栏工作台，支持扩展 Tab，并内置文件查看与编辑、终端、Git 和子智能体工具。

description.en: Pins Git commit authorship to the active environment identity, prioritizing the signed-in GitHub CLI account.
description.zh-CN: 将 Git 提交作者身份固定为当前环境身份，并优先使用已登录的 GitHub CLI 账号。

description.en: Embeds a headed browser in the DSH Web UI so agents can operate a real browser with visible steps.
description.zh-CN: 在 DSH Web UI 中嵌入有头浏览器，让智能体操作真实浏览器并向用户展示每一步。

description.en: Operations toolkit with A/B snapshot upgrades, automatic recovery, rollback, and a diagnostic self-healing command.
description.zh-CN: 运维工具箱，提供 A/B 快照升级、自动恢复、回滚和诊断式自愈命令。

description.en: Per-session and daily DeepSeek API cost, budget, and official-balance tracking for the DSH Web UI, with a history dashboard, peak/off-peak pricing, and one-click official price sync.
description.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness 会话与当日 API 费用、预算与官方余额统计插件：历史看板、峰谷计价与官方价格一键同步。

description.en: A browser-based plugin management console with official guidance for creating DSH plugins.
description.zh-CN: 基于浏览器的 Plugin 管理控制台，并提供官方 DSH Plugin 开发引导。

description.en: GUI image attachments auto-transcribed to local paths plus a view_image bridge to any OpenAI-compatible VLM — end-to-end vision for text-only DeepSeek models.
description.zh-CN: GUI 附件图片自动转写为本地路径，并提供连接任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型的 view_image 桥接——为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供端到端视觉能力。

description.en: Adds image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, visual grounding, pixel diffs, and artifacts.
description.zh-CN: 提供图像问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原、视觉定位、像素差异和 Artifacts 能力。

description.en: Adds a view_image bridge from text-only DeepSeek models to OpenAI-compatible vision-language models.
description.zh-CN: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供连接 OpenAI 兼容视觉语言模型的 view_image 桥接能力。

description.en: A hand-drawn pixel whale companion for the DSH Web UI that reacts to agent activity.
description.zh-CN: 为 DSH Web UI 提供会随智能体活动作出反应的手绘像素鲸鱼伙伴。

description.en: Adds an extensible DSH Web UI panel with 18 offline mini-games for breaks while waiting on agent work.
description.zh-CN: 为 DSH Web UI 添加可扩展的 18 款离线小游戏面板，适合等待智能体工作时休息。

description.en: A draggable, interactive desktop pet companion for the DSH Web GUI with feeding and play interactions.
description.zh-CN: DSH Web GUI 的可拖拽互动桌面宠物伙伴，支持投喂和玩耍等交互。

description.en: Automatically adds emoji to AI replies in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh-CN: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 AI 回复自动添加表情符号。

description.en: Renders interactive UI components inline in assistant replies, including charts, forms, quizzes, Mermaid diagrams, 3D scenes, and model action events.
description.zh-CN: 在助手回复中内联渲染可交互 UI 组件，支持图表、表单、测验、Mermaid 图、3D 场景和模型动作事件。

description.en: A Claude Code-style full-screen terminal interface with streaming thought display, rollback controls, and context/TPS indicators.
description.zh-CN: Claude Code 风格的全屏终端界面，提供流式思考展示、回滚控制及上下文/TPS 指示器。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OpenPencil so agents can create, edit, preview, and validate interactive, multi-page design canvases.
description.zh-CN: 连接 DeepSeek Harness 与 OpenPencil，让智能体创建、编辑、预览和验证可交互的多页面设计画布。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn completes, with outcome and keyword rules.
description.zh-CN: 在 DeepSeek Harness 回合完成时发送桌面通知，并支持按结果和关键词制定规则。

description.en: Enhances file input with paste, drag and drop, and file picking; submitted files are copied into the session workspace.
description.zh-CN: 增强文件输入，支持粘贴、拖拽和选择文件；发送时自动将文件复制到会话工作区。

description.en: Shows persistent conversation progress, live token generation speed, interruption state, and todo reminders in the Web UI.
description.zh-CN: 在 Web UI 中常驻显示会话进度、实时 token 生成速率、中断状态和待办提醒。

description.en: Adds terminal-style Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down navigation through sent messages while preserving the latest unsent draft.
description.zh-CN: 提供终端风格的 Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down 已发送消息导航，并保留最新未发送草稿。

description.en: An embedded task-management engine with decision points, an idea-capture wall, and Linear-style issue storage.
description.zh-CN: 嵌入式任务管理引擎，提供决策点、念头捕获墙和 Linear 风格的 issue 存储。

description.en: Brings the local OpenBiliClaw content-recommendation agent into DSH with a persistent UI and 22 agent-bridge tools.
description.zh-CN: 将本地 OpenBiliClaw 内容推荐智能体接入 DSH，提供常驻界面和 22 个 Agent Bridge 工具。

description.en: Share DeepSeek Harness conversations with a single action.
description.zh-CN: 一键分享 DeepSeek Harness 对话。

description.en: Adds Codex-style text annotations: select text, attach a note to the next message, and receive annotation-aware replies.
description.zh-CN: 提供 Codex 风格文本批注：选中文字、将批注附加到下一条消息，并获得逐条对应的回复。

description.en: Displays background-task progress and a live output tail on the DSH conversation page.
description.zh-CN: 在 DSH 对话页展示后台任务进度和实时输出 tail。

description.en: Adds a right-edge navigation strip for quickly jumping between user-message nodes in a conversation.
description.zh-CN: 添加右侧对话节点导航条，可快速跳转到各个用户消息节点。

description.en: Adds scheduled loops through a /loop command, a loop tool, and an activity status bar.
description.zh-CN: 通过 /loop 命令、loop 工具和活动状态条提供定时循环能力。

description.en: A send_artifact tool that validates model-produced files and delivers structured descriptors through the standard dsh event stream for any client to render.
description.zh-CN: 提供 send_artifact 工具，校验模型产出的文件并通过 dsh 标准事件流交付结构化描述子，任何客户端都可按需呈现。

description.en: Lets the agent write, hot-mount, and reversibly remove its own cordis plugins mid-session, growing new tools, prompt rules, and event hooks that persist across restarts.
description.zh-CN: 让智能体在会话中现场编写、热挂载并可逆卸载自己的 cordis 插件，新工具、提示词规则和事件钩子重启后自动恢复。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness distribution of the Cetus macOS desktop agent: a resident chat companion with global hotkey, screen context, scheduled tasks, and file hand-off.
description.zh-CN: Cetus macOS 桌面智能体的 DeepSeek Harness 发行版：常驻桌面聊天伙伴，支持全局快捷键、屏幕上下文、定时任务和文件递送。

description.en: A shared sticker catalog serving the Web UI picker, a /sticker command, and an agent send_sticker tool, with two character variants and workflow-reaction stickers.
description.zh-CN: 同一份表情包 catalog 同时服务 Web UI 选择器、/sticker 命令和智能体 send_sticker 工具，提供双角色变体与工作流反应表情。

description.en: Branch-based message editing with reroll, retry, and a version timeline for DeepSeek Harness conversations.
description.zh-CN: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话提供基于分支的消息编辑、重新生成、重试和版本时间线。

description.en: Appends a thank-you line to every assistant reply.
description.zh-CN: 给每次助手回复追加一句感谢语。

description.en: See exactly what every request carries: token cost of the AGENTS.md chain, skill catalog and tool schemas, with duplicate/conflict detection and actionable pruning tips (Web UI gauge + context_audit tool, read-only).
description.zh-CN: 看清模型每个请求到底背着多少上下文：指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本逐项量化，自动检测重复与冲突，给出可执行裁剪建议（Web 圆环面板 + context_audit 工具，全程只读）。

description.en: Provides full-text search across DSH, Codex, Claude Code, pi, and OpenCode sessions.
description.zh-CN: 支持跨 DSH、Codex、Claude Code、pi 与 OpenCode 会话的全文搜索。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness cite relevant conversation history from Codex and Claude Code.
description.zh-CN: 让 DeepSeek Harness 引用 Codex 与 Claude Code 中相关的历史对话。

description.en: Adds long-term cross-session memory with Git-branch awareness and background skill evolution.
description.zh-CN: 提供带 Git 分支感知和后台技能进化能力的跨会话长期记忆。

description.en: Helps agents connect to databases and write SQL for data tasks.
description.zh-CN: 帮助智能体连接数据库并编写 SQL 以完成数据任务。

description.en: Local-first artifact & reference library for DeepSeek Harness: auto-collects AI outputs, AI-organizes them with summaries and tags, full-text search across sessions, and per-project overview.
description.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness 本地优先的产物与资料库：自动采集 AI 产出、AI 整理分类（摘要/标签）、跨会话全文检索、项目级总览。

description.en: Embeds isolated web page previews in DSH Web for element annotations and visual adjustments that guide source edits.
description.zh-CN: 在 DSH Web 中嵌入隔离网页预览，通过元素批注和可视化调整指导源码修改。

description.en: Live DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the DSH Web composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.
description.zh-CN: 在 DSH Web 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本场会话花费，自动抓取官方价格并支持峰谷计价。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost as header pills, slash commands, and an agent tool, with configurable pricing and automatic 12-hour sync of the official price list.
description.zh-CN: 以会话头部双胶囊、斜杠命令和智能体工具展示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话费用，单价可配置并每 12 小时自动同步官方价格。

description.en: A switchable QQ2006 skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with a coral-blue theme and retro assets.
description.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的可切换 QQ2006 皮肤，提供珊瑚蓝主题和复古素材。

description.en: Use dsh via grok-build's tui.
description.zh-CN: 借用grok-build tui使用dsh

description.en: A Rust terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.
description.zh-CN: Rust 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。

description.en: An ACP profile plugin and standalone server that exposes the full DSH agent to Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh-CN: ACP profile 插件与独立 server，把完整 DSH agent 接入 Zed 等 ACP 客户端，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: A turn-index sidebar listing every user turn, with click-to-jump navigation and scroll-spy highlighting.
description.zh-CN: 轮次索引侧边栏：列出每一轮用户提问，点击跳转到对应位置，滚动时自动高亮当前轮次。

description.en: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server, letting any MCP client (e.g. Hermes) drive Harness to execute coding tasks.
description.zh-CN: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 能力暴露为 MCP server，让任意 MCP 客户端（如 Hermes）驱动 Harness 执行编码任务。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh-CN: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 dsh-plugin 话题生态、公开评分模型，提供榜单/搜索/推荐工具与设置页排行榜。

description.en: Codex-style skin switcher + custom wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: curated --dsw-alias-* palettes, translucent main canvas/sidebar (overrideTokens) with opacity and blur controls.
description.zh-CN: Codex 风格换肤 + 自定义背景插件：内置多套 --dsw-alias-* 配色，主画布/侧边栏半透明壁纸（overrideTokens），支持透明度与模糊调节。

description.en: One-click collapse of every expanded section in the DSH Web UI (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
description.zh-CN: 一键收起 DSH Web 会话中所有展开的区块（Think 思考行、工具卡片），常驻计数按钮 + 可自定义快捷键。

description.en: Mnemon-powered local memory system with three-tier storage (runtime hot memory, project Documents, and long-term Memory Spaces), supervised writeback, retrieval tools, and a Web UI.
description.zh-CN: Mnemon 驱动的本地记忆系统：三层存储（运行时热记忆、项目档案 Documents、长期记忆体 Memory Spaces），受监督写回、检索工具与 Web UI。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: SQLite + human-editable Markdown mirror, autoDream consolidation, six memory tools, and fully-offline semantic search (local embedding / rerank / clustering), 198 tests.
description.zh-CN: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆插件：SQLite + 可人工编辑的 Markdown 双写，autoDream 后台巩固，6 个记忆工具，完全离线语义检索（本地向量 / 精排 / 聚类），198 个测试。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend statistics for the DSH web UI, with per-model, per-day, and per-session views.
description.zh-CN: DSH Web 的用量与预计花费统计，支持按模型、日期和会话查看。

description.en: Sets a custom DSH Web UI wallpaper with visibility controls for the main interface, sidebar, input, and bubbles.
description.zh-CN: 为 DSH Web UI 设置自定义壁纸，并控制主界面、侧边栏、输入区和气泡的显示。

description.en: Imports conversation histories from coding agents as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with export and sync support for Claude Code.
description.zh-CN: 将编码智能体的对话历史导入为可恢复的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持导出和同步到 Claude Code。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin that routes an 85-skill pack for reverse engineering and authorized security research.
description.zh-CN: 一个为逆向工程和经授权安全研究路由 85 项技能包的 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件。

description.en: Windows desktop client that boots or reuses the Harness gateway and embeds the official web UI, with tray residency and optional launch-at-login.
description.zh-CN: Windows 桌面客户端：打开即拉起或复用 Harness 网关，窗口内嵌官方 Web 界面；托盘常驻，可选开机自启。

description.en: Shows remaining DeepSeek API balance in a floating bottom-right card on the DSH Web page, with auto-refresh and a manual refresh button.
description.zh-CN: 在 DSH Web 页面右下角悬浮卡片展示 DeepSeek API 剩余额度，支持自动刷新与手动刷新。

description.en: Vision toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with a vision_understand tool bridging text-only DeepSeek models to OpenAI-compatible vision APIs.
description.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness 视觉工具包：通过 vision_understand 将纯文本 DeepSeek 模型桥接到 OpenAI 兼容视觉 API。

description.en: Risk-gated auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: safe operations auto-approve, while risky operations require human approval.
description.zh-CN: DSH 风险门控自动审批：安全操作自动批准，风险操作转人工审批。

description.en: ADB device and bench operations for DSH: device discovery, logcat streaming, APK installation, file transfer, and performance snapshots.
description.zh-CN: DSH 的 ADB 设备与台架操作：设备发现、logcat 流、APK 安装、文件传输和性能快照。

description.en: A token-economical DeepSeek Harness agent preset that delegates deep-thinking tasks to expert subagents.
description.zh-CN: 一个节省 token 的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体预设，将深度思考任务委派给专家子智能体。

description.en: A DSH Web UI plugin manager with one-click controls and a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace.
description.zh-CN: DSH Web UI 插件管理器，支持一键控制和 GitHub dsh-plugin 市场。

description.en: A visual GitHub device-flow login tool that synchronizes the token to gh CLI configuration.
description.zh-CN: 一个将令牌同步到 gh CLI 配置的可视化 GitHub 设备码登录工具。

description.en: A living DeepSeek Harness plugin directory with compatibility CI, a searchable catalog, and an in-app plugin store.
description.zh-CN: DSH 插件活目录，提供兼容性 CI、可搜索目录和内置插件商店。

description.en: A DSH plugin scaffolder with tool, events, and Web UI templates plus a built-in smoke test.
description.zh-CN: DSH 插件脚手架，提供工具、事件和 Web UI 模板及内置冒烟测试。

description.en: An in-app DSH Web UI plugin store with browsing, search, installation, compatibility badges, and an installed list.
description.zh-CN: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店，支持浏览、搜索、安装、兼容徽章和已装列表。

description.en: A shared multi-agent task board backed by a Cordis service key.
description.zh-CN: 由 Cordis 服务键支持的共享多智能体任务板。

description.en: Sends IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval requests.
description.zh-CN: 在回合完成、出错或需要审批时发送 IM webhook 和本地通知。

description.en: Exports append-only session logs as human-readable Markdown or HTML.
description.zh-CN: 将只追加会话日志导出为可读的 Markdown 或 HTML。

description.en: Advanced settings manager for DeepSeek Harness with form-level and file-level configuration editing plus a plugin settings SDK.
description.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness 高级设置管理器，支持表单级和文件级配置编辑及插件设置 SDK。

description.en: A Feishu meeting reminder panel with today/tomorrow views and multi-alarm flashing reminders.
description.zh-CN: 飞书会议提醒面板，提供今天/明天视图和多闹钟闪烁提醒。

description.en: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit for DeepSeek Harness, bridging the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and seven agent skills.
description.zh-CN: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 SHOPLINE AI 工具包，接入官方 SHOPLINE Developer MCP 服务并提供七个智能体技能。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness with Feishu, WeCom, and Telegram integrations and per-chat agent sessions.
description.zh-CN: DeepSeek Harness 多平台 IM 网关，集成飞书、企业微信和 Telegram，并提供每聊天独立智能体会话。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI theme studio with built-in presets, customizable palettes, and instant theme switching.
description.zh-CN: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室，提供内置预设、可自定义配色和即时主题切换。

description.en: An OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI with rolling, weekly, and monthly usage views.
description.zh-CN: DSH Web GUI 的 OpenCodeGo 额度监视器，提供滚动、周和月度用量视图。

description.en: Migrates a whole Claude Code or Codex CLI setup into DSH in one command: skills, slash commands, MCP servers, hooks, subagents and permission rules, with a dry-run estimate and a post-move doctor check.
description.zh-CN: 一条命令把整套 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI 配置迁入 DSH：技能、斜杠命令、MCP 服务器、hooks、子代理与权限规则，默认先出预演清单，搬完可用 doctor 体检。
